| style="padding:5px" | <big>'''In order to complete your Comprehensive article nomination, please fill out this form.'''</big><br />Once done, copy <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>/{{SUBPAGENAME}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code> onto the bottom of [{{fullurl:Wookieepedia:Comprehensive article nominations|action=edit&section=1}} the CAN page].

| style="padding:5px" | '''Guide for new nominators:'''
*If the article has any parentheses in its title, replace "<code><nowiki>{{subst:NomPageTitle}}</nowiki></code>" in the top header with the actual name of the article; otherwise leave it as-is.
*The "nomination comments" line is optional and can be used to make some quick notes such as word count, or just make a witty comment.
*The "WookieeProject" line is optional and can be used to identify a [[Wookieepedia:WookieeProjects|WookieeProject]] that the article falls under. {{U|JocastaBot}} will auto-categorize the nomination under whatever project(s) are listed. Full names and WP: shortcuts are permitted.
*Additional notes and/or questions can be left under the bottom "comments" header if you wish.
*The rest of the form should be left as-is.
